description: Add a general, pure, offline, no-LLM scope-exclusion EXTRACTOR + conservative MATCHER as a new module modules/scope_exclusion.py. It scans the feature's own evidence (Jira comments + AC + description + Chalk scope/rules/owned-scenarios) for explicit exclusion statements and derives a set of excluded-subject tokens/phrases from the evidence itself (NO hardcoded '4074' or 'fan-out'). Standalone and independently unit-testable without building a suite. FEAT-003 depends on this module; FEAT-002 ships with its own unit tests so it is verifiable on its own.
steps: Create modules/scope_exclusion.py (pure: no I/O, no network, no LLM, deterministic).
Add a _norm(text) helper mirroring analyst_validity._norm (lowercase, collapse underscores/whitespace).

Add build_exclusion_evidence(jira, chalk) -> str: lowercased blob from jira.comments (each dict's 'body'), jira.acceptance_criteria (str or list), jira.description, jira.summary, and Chalk text via `from .dimension_extractor import _chalk_obligation_text` (fallback to chalk.feature_title/scope/rules on exception, matching analyst_validity.build_feature_evidence). Tolerate None/missing attributes.

Add a module-level list of case-insensitive exclusion marker regexes: 'out of scope', 'scope excluded', r'excluded\b.*\bscope', 'not in scope', r'\bis out of scope\b', r'excluded for\b', r'\bexcluded\b'. For each marker hit, capture the SUBJECT phrase in a small window around the marker (e.g. the clause/sentence containing it, and the noun phrase immediately before 'is out of scope' / after 'excluded for' / 'scope excluded for').

Add extract_excluded_subjects(jira, chalk, log=print) -> set[str]: run markers over the evidence blob; from each captured subject phrase emit a normalized token/phrase set and expand common separator/hyphen variants (e.g. 'cross-environment fan-out' -> {'cross-environment','cross environment','multi-environment','fan-out','fan out'}; 'lower environment' -> {'lower environment'}). Keep expansion rules small, general, and driven by the captured phrase (hyphen<->space, and known cross-env synonyms cross/multi-environment, fan-out/fan out). Return empty set when no marker is found. Log a one-line summary of what was extracted.

Add scenario_matches_excluded(subject, excluded_subjects) -> (bool, matched_phrase): subject is a TestCase or ExtractedScenario; collect its title/summary/validation + steps[].summary/.expected + steps_hint into a normalized text; return (True, phrase) only when a multi-word excluded phrase (>= 2 words, or a distinctive compound like 'fan-out'/'multi-environment'/'across environments') appears. Be conservative: never match on a single broad keyword (e.g. 'environment' alone) that would hit in-scope TCs. Return (False, '') when excluded_subjects is empty.
acceptance_criteria: extract_excluded_subjects on an evidence containing 'Scope excluded for cross-environment fan-out' returns a set containing at least {'cross-environment','fan-out'} and their space variants.
extract_excluded_subjects on evidence with no exclusion language returns an empty set.

scenario_matches_excluded returns True for a scenario titled 'Validate multi-environment fan-out ...' and False for an in-scope scenario titled 'File pickup and parse ...', given the 4074 excluded set.
Module is pure: no imports of network/LLM/streamlit; only re + dimension_extractor._chalk_obligation_text (lazy import).
verification: python -m pytest tests/test_scope_exclusion.py -q   (the test file is authored in FEAT-004; if running FEAT-002 in isolation before it exists, add a minimal inline assertion script and delete it, or defer this exact command to FEAT-004 verification)
findings:
Implemented modules/scope_exclusion.py (pure, deterministic, no-LLM, no-I/O; only `re` + lazy dimension_extractor._chalk_obligation_text). Public API: build_exclusion_evidence(jira, chalk), extract_excluded_subjects(jira, chalk, log=print) -> set[str], scenario_matches_excluded(subject, excluded_subjects) -> (bool, matched_phrase). _norm mirrors analyst_validity._norm.

Evidence blob now includes Jira comments (each dict's 'body'), which analyst_validity.build_feature_evidence does NOT — comments are where the 4074 exclusion lives, so FEAT-003 should source exclusion evidence from build_exclusion_evidence(), not reuse the validity gate's blob.

Markers (case-insensitive): 'scope excluded for <subj>', 'excluded for <subj>', '<subj> is out of scope', plus bare 'scope excluded' / 'out of scope' / 'not in scope' / 'excluded...scope' / 'excluded' (bare markers capture the containing clause as subject). Variant expansion is small and general: hyphen<->space on every token, cross-/multi-environment synonyms, fan-out<->fan out. NO hardcoded '4074' or 'fan-out' trigger — subjects are captured from the evidence sentence itself.

Matcher is conservative: only matches multi-word phrases (>=2 words) or distinctive compounds (any hyphen compound, plus fan-out/multi-environment/cross-environment/across environments). A single broad keyword like 'environment' can never match, so in-scope TCs are safe. Longest-phrase-first so the reported match is most specific. Empty excluded set short-circuits to (False, '').

Verification: `python -c "import modules.scope_exclusion"` exits 0. tests/test_scope_exclusion.py does not exist yet (authored in FEAT-004), so per the verification note I ran a temporary inline assertion script covering all 5 acceptance criteria (import; cross-environment fan-out extraction incl. comment-body path and space/synonym variants; empty set on no-exclusion text; matcher True for 'multi-environment fan-out' scenario / False for 'File pickup and parse'; broad-keyword and empty-set guards; TestCase step-text match) — ALL PASSED — then deleted the script.

The other 10 regression tests pass. tests/test_suite_snapshot.py is slow (full per-feature suite rebuilds) and timed out at 5min on infra rather than asserting.
